# Spelling for the sketch pad

- `typo.js`: Typo.js 1.2.4 (npm `typo-js`), BSD-3-Clause. See `LICENSE-typo.txt`.
- `en_GB.aff`, `en_GB.dic`: en_GB-ise Hunspell dictionary from SCOWL (npm `dictionary-en-gb` 3.0.0), MIT AND BSD. See `LICENSE-en_GB.txt`.

Both are served from this site and loaded the first time the sketch pad checks spelling; no text leaves the browser.
